text: Good morning, I am calling to ask about the evening photography course.
ipa: /ɡʊd ˈmɔːnɪŋ aɪm ˈkɔːlɪŋ tə ɑːsk əˈbaʊt ði ˈiːvnɪŋ fəˈtɒɡrəfi kɔːs/

text: The next course begins on the seventeenth of August and runs for six weeks.
ipa: /ðə nekst kɔːs bɪˈɡɪnz ɒn ðə ˌsevənˈtiːnθ əv ˈɔːɡəst ən rʌnz fə sɪks wiːks/

text: Classes are held on Tuesdays from six thirty until eight fifteen.
ipa: /ˈklɑːsɪz ə held ɒn ˈtjuːzdeɪz frəm sɪks ˈθɜːti ənˈtɪl eɪt ˌfɪfˈtiːn/

text: The standard fee is two hundred and forty dollars, including equipment hire.
ipa: /ðə ˈstændəd fiː ɪz tuː ˈhʌndrəd ən ˈfɔːti ˈdɒləz ɪnˈkluːdɪŋ ɪˈkwɪpmənt ˈhaɪə/

text: Students who register before Friday receive a ten percent discount.
ipa: /ˈstjuːdənts huː ˈredʒɪstə bɪˈfɔː ˈfraɪdeɪ rɪˈsiːv ə ten pəˈsent ˈdɪskaʊnt/

text: Could you spell your surname so that I can reserve a place?
ipa: /kəd ju spel jɔː ˈsɜːneɪm səʊ ðət aɪ kən rɪˈzɜːv ə pleɪs/

text: It is Nguyen, spelled N G U Y E N.
ipa: /ɪt ɪz ŋwiːˈen speld en dʒiː juː waɪ iː en/

text: Thank you; I will email the registration form and payment instructions this afternoon.
ipa: /θæŋk juː aɪl ˈiːmeɪl ðə ˌredʒɪˈstreɪʃən fɔːm ən ˈpeɪmənt ɪnˈstrʌkʃənz ðɪs ˌɑːftəˈnuːn/
